name: windows-service
description: Create a Windows service with install/uninstall and event logging
request_pattern: Create a Windows service in ${language} that ${service_purpose}. Include: service installer/uninstaller, start/stop/pause handlers, Windows Event Log integration, configuration via app.config or registry, error recovery settings, and a health check endpoint. Add unit tests.

variables.service_purpose: monitors a directory for new files and processes them
